# Content Idea

## Summary
An unscheduled thought, captured at the moment it lands — usually mid-class. The
backlog feeds the calendar: drag an idea onto a day, or schedule it for today,
and it becomes a planned ContentPiece that keeps a link back.

## Composition
`title` plus a free-text `thought`, optional `themes` (base Tag) and an optional
`hunchPlatform` — a guess, not a commitment, which is the point of a backlog
entry.

## Finding worth recording
This extends `CardDef` directly rather than the matrix **Note** concept, because
there is no Note CardDef in this realm — its only evidence is a ticket message
FieldDef. Note therefore remains unproven as a base card, and this app is where
that showed up.

## Non-goals
Ideas never appear on the calendar. An idea with a date is a ContentPiece; the
distinction is the whole value of the backlog.
